session_title: New Year's Eve Online Gaming Session: Farewell and Welcome

content.text: Hey, Lu Chenguang! Happy New Year's Eve! My boyfriend and I are out, but I suddenly thought of you. How about starting an online game together to ring in the New Year? Consider it the anniversary team-building for our 'Field Research' project! I'll send you a game promo image to see if you're interested.

Haha, Lin Xingwan, Happy New Year! Of course, I’d love to. I was just wondering how to kill time. The picture you sent is from "Peace Elite," right? I remember we analyzed its mechanics during our previous game collaboration—it’s perfect for a quick match.

Exactly! That's the one. I'm getting ready to go online, and my boyfriend is waiting beside me, but we can play a round first. Let's consider it a revisit to our 'gaming as a social medium' research, and a way to ring in the New Year.

Okay, I'll log in right away. Speaking of which, we've collaborated on quite a few projects this year, from the health dashboard to the campus cat catalog, and then to public opinion analysis. Each time, we've managed to turn our interests into something meaningful.

Yeah, remember that time you stayed up all night programming and sent a screenshot of the terminal? I turned a health crisis into a tech project. Looking at the annual data report now, your sleep has improved a lot—the point incentives really work.

Thanks to your social monitoring module! However, I've been optimizing the campus information aggregator demo recently, using the sentiment analysis technology we discussed, and it feels more efficient than before.

Wow, that sounds amazing! I just received a New Year's message here, let me share it with you. By the way, shall we meet in the game? We could find a mountaintop to set off fireworks—a virtual New Year's celebration can be quite meaningful too.
Got the picture, the festive atmosphere is really strong. Alright, see you in the game! I'm already in the open-world map, looking for a high spot. The night scene in the code should look great.
I'm here! The view from this mountaintop is amazing; you can see the lights of the entire virtual city. Let me set off some fireworks—consider it our New Year's Eve celebration!

Haha, I set one off here too, sending you a picture of the fireworks. The colors and shapes are quite dazzling, and the code rendered it nicely. This year, from health projects to public welfare development, we’ve really been through a lot.

Got the picture, it's stunning! But what makes me happiest is how we complement each other every time we collaborate—your tech passion paired with my social butterfly skills, and we even launched a campus stray animal adoption platform.

Yeah, the feedback on that platform is pretty good, and the server monitoring shows it's running stable. By the way, have you bought your internship gear yet? Remember we talked about rational spending—don't let FOMO get the best of you.

Don't worry, I've already accounted for the time cost using the 'investment' framework, and it's all sorted. As for you, try to stay up less during the New Year. Your health dashboard data has just started to improve—don't let it slip back again.
I'll keep that in mind—efficiency is key. But working with you on these projects makes me feel that technology truly can change the world, even if it's just small things on campus.
Completely agree! From reviewing digital art exhibitions to analyzing public opinion, we always manage to blend experience with technology. It's almost midnight—shall we count down together?
Okay, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1—Happy New Year, Lin Xingwan! May you create more hit content in the coming year and continue to introduce me to fun things.

Happy New Year, Lu Chenguang! I also wish your open-source project continues to grow, but remember to balance it with life. I'm really glad to have a friend like you who can work on projects together and also have fun together.
Same to you! So, let's call it a day for now? Go spend time with your boyfriend. I'll tidy up a bit and then rest too. Let's do another 'field research' together next year!
Okay, good night! Stay in touch, and let's keep our health board points going. Happy New Year, dear friend!
